title: Choose the admin composition
question: The public site is already the neighbourhood pizarra. This round picks how staff work on that board: drawers, a morning slate, or a map workbench. Lock one.

options.label: The filing wall
options.lineage: Colombian oficina ficha drawers plus the public letter-board
options.thesis: Work lives in labelled drawers; pulling one opens a ruled list, and a ficha slides in from the right.
materials: Big Shoulders only on the drawer labels
options.viewport: A left column of inverted drawer labels (Negocios, Consultas, Seguimientos, Taxonomía, Importar, Ajustes). The remaining board is a dense ruled business list. Selecting a row slides a ficha from the right with identity, contact, hours, and publish blockers. Locale ES/EN and the signed-in name sit on a thin top rail, not a hero.
options.risk: One extra click if the drawer column steals width from the list on a laptop.

raised.raise: Rows are live entities: status restyles the row in place; columns never jump.
The open ficha shows what blocks publish as opposing forces, not a toast.
ES/EN is a stacked bilingual label pair on chrome, never a second colour.

options.label: Today’s slate
options.lineage: Morning shop slate: what is due, what arrived, what is still a draft
options.thesis: Staff land on three urgency columns; every other screen is a drill-down from a ticket on that slate.
options.viewport: Three equal columns fill the first viewport: Vencidos, Consultas nuevas, Borradores. Each ticket is a ruled menu row. Opening one expands a ficha across the lower board. Nav to full lists is secondary, under the slate.
options.risk: A quiet day looks empty, and a busy day hides the full business catalogue behind the home board.

options.label: Map workbench
options.lineage: The public /buscar split, turned into an editor
options.thesis: The map is the desk; the list is a thin index; the editor docks beside the pin you are placing.
options.viewport: A Cúcuta map owns two-thirds of the board. A slim left index lists businesses. Selecting a pin docks the editor on the right for address, service area, and hours. Taxonomy, enquiries, and settings are tucked behind a command strip.
options.risk: It reads as the public directory, which you named as a failure, and it starves list-heavy work (enquiries, taxonomy, import).

options.label: Staff departure board
options.lineage: Rail concourse split-flap, fused onto the enamel pizarra
options.thesis: The catalogue is one full-bleed table; flaps never move, only the letters on the selected row invert.
materials: no steel frame, no amber lamps
options.viewport: Name, barrio, status, follow-up, WhatsApp as fixed columns across the whole board. Search sits in the top rail at body size. Opening a row expands the ficha as extra ruled lines under that row, not a side panel.
options.case: Holds product clarity: editors scan and act in one grid. Identification is shared with the public board, so it can drift into looking like /buscar.
options.risk: Inline expansion fights the deep business editor (hours, media, verification).

options.label: Stacked boxes
options.lineage: Archive box wall, fused as enamel drawers stacked by status
options.thesis: Draft, active, and closed listings are stacks of labelled ends; you pull a box halfway, then open the ficha.
options.viewport: Three tall stacks by status fill the board. Each end label is name + barrio in condensed caps. The pulled box reveals the ficha as the interior, not a separate page.
options.case: Holds identification with filing work. Loses clarity once taxonomy, import, and settings need a home that is not a box.
options.risk: Stacks look playful and hide the overdue work that a list would surface first.

options.label: Force diagram
options.lineage: Tensegrity column as a relationship graph
options.thesis: Listings, taxonomy, and enquiries as struts you can trace to a counterforce.
options.viewport: A network in the centre with leader lines out to listing nodes.
options.case: Loses product clarity: daily CRUD is not load-tracing.
options.kept: Publish blockers as visible opposing forces on the open ficha.

options.label: Glyph density
options.lineage: ASCII live scene as a monospace grid
options.thesis: The whole admin is one character grid; tone is glyph density.
options.case: Loses audience identification for Cúcuta staff on the enamel board.

options.label: Crisis wall
options.thesis: Monumental countdowns and hazard bands for overdue work.
options.viewport: A black wall with bilingual stacked labels and a huge follow-up countdown.
options.case: Loses identification: MK1GROUP editors are not in a mecha cockpit.
options.kept: Bilingual stacked labels on chrome, never a second accent colour.

options.label: Seeded identity
options.lineage: Parametric brand that reseeds the surface
options.thesis: A mark reseeds palette and layout from live inputs.
options.viewport: A parameter panel that restyles the dashboard.
options.case: Loses both axes: the visual world is already pinned and must not reseed.
